FAQ

Common questions

Can ABiT build custom Odoo modules?

Yes. ABiT builds custom modules, reports, print formats, workflows and integrations around standard Odoo apps.

Can you improve existing Odoo customizations?

Yes. ABiT can review current custom code, identify stability or upgrade risks and prioritize fixes.

Do you connect Odoo with ecommerce platforms?

Yes. ABiT can connect Odoo with ecommerce, payment, warehouse, shipping and finance systems through APIs and custom connectors.
